_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. dribbble.com's declared token layer is the Shoelace --sl-* set (its --sl-color-primary-* ramp re-bound to the Dribbble pink) harvested into raw/css-vars.json; the Rails-era mini-master styles that paint most of the signed-out surface hold their values inline, so they are measured leaves from raw/components-computed.json. Declared variables become var leaves; painted colours, geometry and the Mona Sans stack are measured leaves. The dark set names the ink surfaces painted inside the light page (dark pills, the certified chip), not a user theme.
